Several weeks (you can only hand in 1 tome every 20 hours)

The dwarf {npc:Cael}, sage of Farmine, wants to learn everything about the continent of Zao. Scattered around Zao are 12 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}: most are found during the missions of other Zao quests. Each tome you hand him unlocks something new: decorations and backpacks for sale, trades with NPCs, the serpent teleport and access to the Corruption Hole and the Zao Palace.
Maybe you can help an old dwarf in his search for knowledge and get something out of it yourself...
No minimum level, but level 100+ is recommended.

1. How to hand in the tomes to Cael

Farmine is underground in Zao. Go to **Kazordoon**, go down to the underground port of the {wiki:Steamship} and talk to {npc:Brodrosch}: say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port of Farmine, next to {npc:Thorgrin}. {npc:Cael} is **north** of the steamship and the armoury, a few floors up. All the tomes are in Zao: from Farmine go out to the Zao steppe and follow it from there to each location.

To leave Farmine, go back to the steamship of {npc:Thorgrin} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. After finishing The New Frontier Quest you can also use the magic carpet of {npc:Melian}, at the top of the mountain above Farmine.

Go to Farmine and talk to {npc:Cael}. Say {key:hi}, {key:tome of knowledge} and {key:yes}. Then say {key:zao} for him to tell you what he has learned and, at the end, the keyword he highlights (for example {key:lizard}, {key:minotaur}, {key:Draken}...).

You can only hand in **one tome every 20 hours** (real time). Until you complete the first 8 missions of The New Frontier Quest you can only hand in 6 tomes; to hand in more you have to finish The New Frontier Quest.
Go to the orc camp **north-west** of Zao and enter the fortress. Once underground, go **north** and then **west**.

You will find all kinds of {creature:Orc|orcs} (except {creature:Orc Rider|Orc Riders} and {creature:Orc Marauder}) and, at times, high-class lizards or a {creature:Dragon Lord} pulled by other players.

On the way you have to use {spell:Levitate} (or {item:Parcel|Parcels}) to go up at one point and, further on, use your **weapon** to break a wall. Keep going to the chest with the {item:Tome of Knowledge}.
Use a weapon to break the wall (3/6)

Go back the same way as in the images: pass the wall you broke, go down at the spot where you levitated (with {spell:Levitate}: "exani hur down") and climb to the surface where you came in. Then return across the Zao steppe to Farmine.
3. Second and third tomes: Muggy Plains
You can pick up the second and third tomes on the same trip, if you have already unlocked the necessary missions.

The second tome becomes available after you unlock mission 2 (*The Maw of the Dragon*) of the {wiki:An Uneasy Alliance Quest|An Uneasy Alliance Quest}. The third is picked up during mission 7 of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest}.

Use the teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains|Muggy Plains} and go up. There is only one possible path to the tower. The teleport is an ancient lizard teleport in the **north** of the Zao steppe, south of the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks|Dragonblaze Peaks}, and it only works for those who have already done the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest}. To come back, follow the same route in reverse to the teleport and return across the steppe to Farmine.

Continuation of the route from the Muggy Plains
Second tome: top of the tower
Climb to the **top floor** of the tower. The {item:Tome of Knowledge} is in a chest next to the crystal.
Final route to the tower of the 2nd tome

During mission 7 of The New Frontier Quest, follow the same route from the Muggy Plains teleport (go up the only possible path) and pick up the third {item:Tome of Knowledge} at the end of that route.

9. Ninth tome: Children of the Revolution, mission 5
Chest in the building to the south

During mission 5 of the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest|Children of the Revolution Quest}, when you go up the stairs, head **south**. The tome is in a chest inside the building. This tome can **only** be obtained during this mission.

Watch out for the {creature:Lizard Chosen|Lizard Chosen}, the {creature:Eternal Guardian|Eternal Guardians} and the {creature:Lizard Gate Guardian|Lizard Gate Guardians}. During the mission, waves of lizards arrive: look for a corner where you can shelter from them.

10. Tenth tome: the secret hole (Corruption Hole)

After handing in **8 tomes** to Cael, you can enter a secret hole at the far **north-east** of Zao. To get there, go down the ramp on the **east** side of the temple you visit in missions 4 and 5 of the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest|Children of the Revolution Quest}. Then go down the hole.
Blue = you start here; pink = go down

Inside there are {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards}, a {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest}, many {creature:Lizard Chosen} and 4 {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}, besides the {item:Tome of Knowledge}.
The 4 Ghastly Dragons are in the same area as the tome. Go prepared or in a team.
Blue = you start here; red = tome; pink = Ghastly Dragons
Go back to the spot where you fell through the hole and climb up with the {item:Rope}; then climb the ramp on the east side of the temple and return to Farmine the way you came.
The gates of {wiki:Zzaion|Zzaion} only open during the {wiki:Zao Raids|orc raid on Zzaion}. It is the only chance to enter the lizard fortress.
Bring a strong team: you can have several lizards, high-class lizards, {creature:War Wolf|War Wolves} and all kinds of orcs attacking you at the same time.
Go to the **southernmost** building of Zzaion: it is the tallest tower. The tome is in a chest on the **top floor** of that tower.
Location of the 11th tome tower (the chest is on the top floor)
To leave, go down the tower and leave Zzaion through the gates you came in by **while the raid is still going on** (it is the only time they are open); then return across the steppe to Farmine.

With 10 tomes handed in you can enter the {wiki:Zao Palace|Zao Palace}, deep under the lizard mountain (below the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks|Dragonblaze Peaks}). Cross the {wiki:Zao Palace Antechambers|Zao Palace Antechambers} and go in through the marked sealed door. Fight your way through the hordes of {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters} and go to the marked chest to pick up the tome. To leave, go back the same way to the sealed door and the Antechambers.
Chest of the 12th tome, Zao Palace
The floor with the chest is full of {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}.
A level 150+ player can pick up this tome alone if they clear a path to the chest with {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb Runes}: that way the Ghastly Dragons are much less dangerous.
13. Rewards by number of tomes handed in
Each tome handed in to Cael unlocks a reward, according to the total number of tomes already handed in.
This is the list of what you get with each tome handed in:
Buy {item:Dragon Tapestry|Dragon Tapestries} from {npc:Pompan} for 80 gp each.
Buy {item:Minotaur Backpack|Minotaur Backpacks} from {npc:Pompan} for 200 gp each.
Buy a {item:Lizard Weapon Rack} from {npc:Esrik} for 500 gp each.
Trade a {item:Bunch of Ripe Rice} for 10 {item:Rice Ball|Rice Balls} with {npc:Swolt}, as many times as you like.
Buy {item:Dragon Backpack|Dragon Backpacks} from {npc:Pompan} for 200 gp each.
Buy {item:War Drum|War Drums} and a {item:Didgeridoo} from {npc:Cael}.

Use the serpent head teleport on the summit of the mountain where Farmine is. It takes you to the teleport in the north of Zao, south of the Dragonblaze Peaks (the teleport to the Muggy Plains). It is **one-way only**!
Enter the hole in the far north-east of Zao (many {creature:Lizard Chosen} and 4 {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}).

Sell {item:Zaoan Helmet}, {item:Zaoan Armor}, {item:Zaoan Legs}, {item:Zaoan Shoes}, {item:Drakinata}, {item:Traditional Sai}, {item:Zaoan Sword}, {item:Drachaku}, {item:Twin Hooks}, {item:Zaoan Halberd} and {item:Wailing Widow's Necklace} to {npc:Esrik}.
Enter the {wiki:Zao Palace|Zao Palace} (Draken Warmasters and Ghastly Dragons).
Buy a {item:Dragon Statue (Item)|Dragon Statue} from {npc:Cael} after bringing him a {item:Red Lantern}.
{npc:Cael} makes you a {item:Dragon Throne} if you bring him a {item:Red Piece of Cloth} (at most once every 35 days).
5,000 experience for each extra tome (still 1 tome every 20 hours).
With 4 tomes handed in, take a {item:Bunch of Ripe Rice} to {npc:Swolt}, in the Farmine tavern. Say {key:rice} and {key:yes} to receive 10 {item:Rice Ball|Rice Balls}.
With 11 tomes handed in, take a {item:Red Lantern} to {npc:Cael} and say {key:lantern} and {key:yes}. He gives you the {item:Dragon Statue (Item)|Dragon Statue} wrapped: unwrap it at home.
With 12 tomes handed in, take a {item:Red Piece of Cloth} to {npc:Cael} and say {key:cloth} and {key:yes}. He gives you the {item:Dragon Throne} wrapped.
Cael only makes one Dragon Throne for you every 5 weeks (35 days). Do not destroy it!
If you manage to get more than 12 tomes, keep handing them in to Cael with {key:tome of knowledge} and {key:yes}: you get 5,000 experience for each one (one every 20 hours).
Before update 9.83 you had to wait 24 hours between hand-ins; now it is 20 hours.
Some tomes are mission rewards (4th and 8th) and others can only be found during specific missions (for example, the 9th).
When you hand in the 7th tome, Cael tells you about a lizard relic next to the carpet pilot, at the top of the mountain: it is the serpent teleport.
